content: {"answerable": true, "answer": "New residents with children under 19 apply for the Canada child benefit with form RC66, which also applies them for the groceries benefit [s16-c500-000]. Send the form by mail with proof of birth for each child [s16-c500-000]. Newcomers can apply for benefit payments before filing their first tax return using form RC151 or form RC66 [s10-c500-000]."}
